title: Write the script templates of an issuer response

cases.says: tag 91 comes first, then each script with its identifier and commands in the order given, and nothing at all when there is nothing to send
a template's length counts its encoded elements, tags and lengths included, so the template parses as a TLV list
a value of 128 bytes or more is announced with 81 or 82 and the length, for commands and templates alike
the script identifier is optional, and a script without one has no 9F18 element, not an empty one

origin.section: 18.5. The Response Carries the ARPC in Tag 91 and the Scripts as TLV Inside TLV
